title.zh: SmartLingo 响应式字阶与首页视觉层级
title.en: SmartLingo responsive typography and homepage hierarchy

purpose.zh: 缩小平板和桌面首页过大的标题及卡片字阶，同时保持正文易读、明暗对比和移动端自然换行。
purpose.en: Reduce oversized tablet and desktop homepage headings and card type while preserving readable body copy, contrast, and natural mobile wrapping.

zh: 将学习入口主标题上限从 76px 降至 52px，优化行高、字距和首屏留白。
将 Flash／Max 卡片标题上限从 60px 降至 36px，并收紧 Guru 标题和卡片间距。
保留可读正文及原有深色／浅色高对比配色；付款、会员权益和数据库不变。
en: Cap the learning-entry headline at 52px instead of 76px, with calmer line-height, tracking, and first-screen spacing.
Cap Flash/Max card headings at 36px instead of 60px and tighten Guru headings and card spacing.
Retain readable body text and the existing high-contrast light/dark palette; commerce, entitlements, and database remain unchanged.

zh: 首页及共用学习入口字阶、WebKit 字号回归检查；不改变路径 URL、支付价格或数据库结构。
en: Homepage and shared learning-entry typography plus a WebKit type-scale regression check; no route URL, price or database-schema changes.

zh: 复用既有学习路径组件与配色，只调整其 CSS 字阶和间距；在既有真实 WebKit 布局门禁加入计算后字号检查。
en: Reuse existing learning-path components and colors, changing only CSS type scale and spacing; add computed-font-size checks to the existing real-WebKit layout gate.

zh: 构建、零警告 lint、TypeScript、全量测试与中英首页五种屏宽的 WebKit 字阶／布局检查；发布后核验生产页面与精确提交记录。
en: Build, zero-warning lint, TypeScript, full tests and WebKit type-scale/layout checks at five widths in Chinese and English; verify production and exact release commit after deployment.

zh: 本次仅需匿名页面验收；不产生真实付款或改变订阅状态。
en: This round requires anonymous-page acceptance only; no real payment or subscription-state change.

zh: 保留十二种界面语言、现有 flash／max 路由与教室权限；共用字阶同时修正各语言入口。
en: Preserve twelve interface languages, existing flash/max routes and classroom permissions; the shared type scale improves every locale's entry page.

rollback.zh: 无需数据回退；若需撤销本次字阶调整，重新部署上一成功提交即可。
rollback.en: No data rollback is required; redeploy the previous successful commit to revert this typography change.
